headline: Clarity Act Failure Shifts Crypto Growth to Asia and Middle East, Apex CEO Warns
summary: The legislative failure of the U.S. Clarity Act will drive digital asset businesses toward faster-moving jurisdictions across Asia and the Middle East, according to Apex Group CEO Peter Hughes.
why: Regulatory clarity in the United States directly influences where cryptocurrency startups, venture capital, and institutional service providers deploy long-term capital.

impacts.name: United States
impacts.why: Regulatory inertia threatens to lose fintech and digital asset market share to overseas financial hubs.
